title: Some 720,000 Russian soldiers killed in the war, in leaked data deemed authentic by the independent Mediazona news website (Ukraine Battlefield update, day 1,734)
lede: The newly authenticated death rolls show a war hollowing out Russia’s working-age male population, stripping poor regions of fathers and breadwinners at a pace that already eclipses all Soviet conflicts since 1945.

title: Stressed doctors and swamped hospitals secretly using AI amid confusing EU rules, report finds
lede: Hospitals depend on AI they do not control, while EU-funded health startups rarely reach public hospitals in Europe, a report reveals. Its findings also show that some doctors upload sensitive patient data to commercial AI chatbots like ChatGPT and Gemini without approval, and that hospitals struggle to comply with overlapping EU rules on privacy and AI.

title: A Compliance Market Nobody Enforces Is No Market at All: How Article 6 Is Killing the Supply It Was Meant to Create
lede: Countries have authorized more than 348 million carbon credits under Article 6, yet only about 150,000 have been delivered. As CORSIA's 2028 deadline nears, BlueGreen CEO Eyal Harel argues that sovereign red tape is choking the supply compliance markets need.
